functions.name: WorktreeListBlock
params:
{
  action,
  entries = [],
  rows = [],
  eventId,
  title,
  toolUsage,
  isLoading = false,
  isFailed = false,
}

callGraph.callee:
text
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) =>
      line
        .trim()
        .match(/^\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/)?.[1]
        ?.trim()
    )
    .filter((name): name is string => Boolean(name))
    .map

functions.name: OrgSendMessageBlock
params:
{
  args,
  result,
  status,
  eventId,
  sessionId,
  hideHeader = false,
}

callGraph.callee:
raw
    .filter(
      (item): item is Record<string, unknown> =>
        item !== null && typeof item === "object"
    )
    .map
